ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $OC$ bisects $\angle AOB$, and $\angle BOC=22^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle AOB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since OC bisects $\angle AOB$ and $\angle BOC=22^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOB =2\angle BOC=44^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $\angle AOB = \boxed{44^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are three rays OA, OC, OB with common endpoint O, among which OB is horizontal to the right, OA is slanting upward, and OC is located between OA and OB, therefore OC is inside ∠AOB.
